snippet.title: Star Fox Adventures – Nintendo Classics – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Star Fox Adventures is landing on Nintendo GameCube – Nintendo Classics later today! Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/nintendo-gamecube-nintendo-classics-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Alongside his pal Tricky, Fox explores a planet populated by dinosaurs, but who knows what they might uncover?
